'''Skywalkers''' is a cancelled Decipher expansion (CardGuide #34; this wiki #34 after [[Death Star II Starter Decks]]). It is not the Premiere interrupt [[Skywalkers]].

It was planned as the first of three character-themed expansions after [[Death Star II]], scheduled for November 2000. The set would have focused on Luke, Leia, Vader, and the relationships among them. Decipher's working name for the new mechanic was "Lichtenstein": instead of printing new versions of those characters, Lichtenstein cards would grant new capabilities to existing character cards already in play.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref><ref name="after">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050307015419/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/whatisit/afterdeathstar.html After Death Star II] at Decipher.com (archive, 7 March 2005)</ref>

The Death Star II starter-deck rulebook advertised Skywalkers together with [[Shadows of the Empire]] as the next two expansions. Lucasfilm then asked Decipher to mix ''The Phantom Menace'' into the original-trilogy game. [[Tatooine]] was originally framed as a Skywalker-family set and was rebuilt around podracing and Episode I characters.<ref name="after" />

No retail packaging was released. Do not treat encyclopedia mock-ups of unreleased booster packs as authentic product photography.
